title: A look into Calgary's past
description: Use the microfiche machine in the Calgary Central Library to view a newspaper that is at least 50 years old. Photo: the screen, with the newspaper's date showing.

title: Spot an air ambulance
description: From the public paths outside Foothills Hospital, film an air ambulance coming in to land on the roof of the McCaig Tower. Stay on the paths and well clear of the entrances.

title: Run backwards
description: Film each other running 100 m backwards on the track, then play the videos in reverse to see whose run looks more normal.

title: Film a duck
description: Film a duck on the pond at West Campus Park.

title: Closest to $20.26
description: At Market Mall, race each other to find an item priced as close to $20.26 as you can. Photograph the price tag.

title: Birdwatching
description: Identify and photograph 5 different species of birds at Inglewood Bird Sanctuary. Photo: your favourite of the five.

title: The wisdom of the crowd
description: Ask people near the Calgary Tower to guess its height until the average of all the guesses is within 5 m of the real value (191 m). Photo: your tally of guesses, with the Tower behind it.

title: Planespotting
description: Identify and photograph a Boeing 737, an Airbus A320 and a Boeing 787. Photo: your best plane of the three.

title: Lucky eights
description: 8 is a lucky number in Chinese culture. In Chinatown, set an eight-minute timer and try to photograph 8 instances of the number 8. Photo: your favourite 8.

title: Price hunt at Chinook
description: At Chinook Centre, race each other to find an item priced as close to $20.26 as you can. Photograph the price tag.

title: Walk the +15
description: Get from Centennial Place to CORE Shopping Centre using only the +15 skywalks, never touching the street. Photo: the two of you in the last skywalk before CORE.

title: Play foosball
description: Play a game of foosball, first to 5 goals, on the tables in the Engineering building. Photo: the table, with the final score showing.

title: Downtown view
description: Go onto the roof of the Art Parkade and take a picture of Downtown. Identify five Downtown buildings in your photo.

title: City wildlife
description: For 20 minutes, take pictures of as many wildlife animals as you can with 1 point for birds, 3 points for rodents, and 5 points for large mammals. Photo: your best animal shot.

title: Animal bingo
description: See how many of these you can take a picture of in 5 minutes. Animal sleeping, a baby animal and its mother, an albino animal, a swimming animal, an animal eating. Photo: your favourite of the five.

title: Guess the loop
description: Explore Prince's Island together for 10 minutes without looking anything up. Then each guess how long the full loop of the island takes to walk, walk it, and see who was closer.

title: Hide and seek at Glenmore
description: Start at the Glenmore Dam viewpoint. One of you hides somewhere along the paths you think can be found in 10 minutes, and the other finds them and takes a photo. Swap, and see who judged the time better. Stay on the paths and well back from the water.

title: Ask the info desk
description: New to campus? Find the Information Centre in MacEwan Student Centre. Each of you picks one thing you'd want to know, like where to print or where the quiet study spots are, and find the answer together. Photo: the two of you pointing at the answer on a map or sign.

title: Where to get help
description: Find Student Wellness Services in MacEwan Student Centre, where students can see a doctor or a counsellor, so you both know where it is before you need it. Then find the nearest water bottle filler. Photo: the Student Wellness sign.

title: Library basics
description: In the Taylor Family Digital Library, find where you'd ask a librarian for help and where you can book a study room. Photo: the help desk or the room-booking sign.

title: Through the Arch
description: Find the University of Calgary Arch, the big sculpture on the south side of campus, and work out the best spot to frame the campus through it. Photo: campus framed in the Arch.

title: Make the Oval tiny
description: Stand well back from the Olympic Oval and take a forced-perspective photo where one of you holds the whole building between two fingers. Swap and see whose looks most convincing. Photo: your best one.

title: Copy the Speed Skater
description: Find the Speed Skater sculpture by the Olympic Oval and both strike its pose as exactly as you can. Photo: the two of you mid-stride beside it.

title: Meet the Prairie Chicken
description: Find the Prairie Chicken sculpture on campus. Each guess what it's made of and how tall it is, then check the plaque or look closely. Photo: both of you doing your best prairie chicken next to it.

title: Initials hunt
description: Starting at MacEwan Hall, find a building or room sign that starts with the first letter of each of your names. Closest walk wins. Photo: one of you pointing at either sign.

title: Campus from memory
description: Sit somewhere in the Garden of Learning. Each of you sketches a map of campus from memory in two minutes, then walk to the nearest campus map and see whose was closer. Photo: both sketches side by side.

title: Best seat on campus
description: Walk from the Taylor Family Digital Library and each pick the one outdoor seat on campus you'd most like to read in, then show each other. Vote on a winner. Photo: the view from the winning seat.
